title: Grogu
subtitle: Clan of 2
description: Grogu was just another bounty for The Mandalorian Din Djarin, but soon after finding the youngling, it became clear something was different. Mando wasn't able to turn Grogu over for the Empire, and instead assumed guardianship. The two forged an unbreakable bond and traveled across the galaxy together. Grogu was strong in the force, but chose another path besides that of the Jedi. He chose the Mandalorian way.
